lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Tl4Hg4 (reduced formula Ba2TlHg) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ba centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Hg and Tl centers each have 9 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Ba 12-vertex and Hg 9-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Ba and Tl 9-vertex polyhedra.
